why_no_gpu: the arm loads real libnccl behind our NET plugin and reads its props/counters: no device is touched, and a CPU-bound job on the GPU queue is killed at ~0.2% GPU use. The ABI it measures is NCCL's, not the driver's.

cpu_runs.what: the arm: 20 runs per wheel (cu12, cu13); plugin accepted and used, 0 signals, 0 other non-zero exits
the agreement check the arm asserts on: the printed counters line vs the counters file (rc=0 agree; a log doctored to isend=0 gives rc=1 naming 'isend: printed 0 vs file 16')

wall_bound_note: run.sh 20 measured 63 s wall at load 13.46 in the run whose log is output.log (the same arm has measured 69-70 s at load 15-19). The 900 s bound exists so a loaded box cannot be misread as a failing arm.
arm_sources_note: output.log is the capture of run.sh at the tip recorded in the bead comment; these sha256s let a reader check that the code which produced it is the code in the tree.
